column3: Saori Route ・ Resolve is Essential
*sigh*...
Everyone is just so annoying...
Crap... she's just adding fuel to the fire...
I have to do something to get Kirino out of her bad mood...!
But, if I screw it up, she'll just get angry at me instead.
I'll just have to shut up and see how this plays out.
Kirino, I...
You keep your mouth shut. This is Saori's problem, right?
Well yeah, that's true, but...
Kyousuke-shi, you don't have to cover for me.
After all, I am the one at fault.
After her harsh words, Kirino pivoted her head back to Saori.
Hey...
You need to accept the fact that you 【love Otaku hobbies】.
Does anyone gain anything out of you lying to yourself?
Kiririn-shi...
But, I have already decided... ahaha...
That dry laugh sounded like she was suffocating...
Well, I'm done then.
Hey, wait Kirino.
...What?
Don't just say "I see." Isn't Saori still your friend?
Well that "friend" won't listen, so there's nothing I can do.
That's why I'm done.
Kirino...
Kyousuke-shi...
